page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Flex.1-16 is a virtual machine instance powered by the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor using the arm64 architecture. The server delivers 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 3.6 GHz with a single thread per core execution model. It is allocated 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage or discrete GPU accelerators, relying entirely on remote block storage attachments for persistent disk operations. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. Because the hardware relies on dedicated physical cores rather than simultaneous multithreading, it delivers consistent per-core execution without resource contention from adjacent virtual threads.

With an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio, VM.Standard.A4.Flex.1-16 provides a memory-dense footprint suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require extensive parallel core counts. Typical deployment targets include caching layers, in-memory datastores, moderate database systems, backend application services, and general containerized tasks compiled for arm64.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Flex.1-16 is an arm64 compute instance based on the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor running at 3.6 GHz. It provides 2 dedicated physical cores across 2 vCPUs with 1 thread per core, accompanied by 16.0 GB of system RAM, resulting in an 8.0 GB per core memory profile. The instance includes 1 complimentary public IPv4 address and features no integrated local storage or discrete graphics acceleration, depending on network-attached storage for disk requirements. The single-threaded dedicated core implementation guarantees deterministic CPU access without hyperthreading overlap. Given the high memory allocation relative to compute units, this server is suitable for memory-intensive tasks, caching nodes, intermediate relational databases, web backends, and arm64-native container hosting.
